headline: Review of a large grant form and Council on Aging requests, plus other old business and thank you notes.
summary: The agenda includes a review of a large grant form and requests from the Council on Aging. Other old business and thank you notes are also listed.
location: City Hall Salem, First Floor, Conference Room 2

City of Salem, Massachusets
